name: Eindhoven University of Technology
summary: Technical university in Eindhoven; 13 English-taught BSc programmes, from applied physics to industrial design, all asking for Maths AA HL.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma with Maths AA HL for every bachelor's; engineering and design ones add Physics HL. An IB Diploma taught only in English, or English A HL at 5, covers English.

apply.via: Studielink, then TU/e's OSIRIS application form

dates.label: Selection programmes: complete application and fee paid, 23:59 CET
All other programmes: complete application, 23:59 CET

programmes.name: Applied Mathematics
programmes.about: Mathematics used to model real problems from industry and government, from image processing to supply chains, then calculated and solved; you learn to work with specialists from other fields.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Applied Physics
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL.
programmes.about: Light and sound, flow and heat, atoms and particles, studied to find nature's laws and turn them into technology, with an emphasis on applying physics in Eindhoven's high-tech setting.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Architecture, Urbanism and Building Sciences
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL. Numerus fixus: apply by 15 January; ranked on grades, an online test (13 March 2027) and a campus day (3 April 2027).
programmes.about: How buildings, neighbourhoods and cities are designed, built and reshaped: architecture, urban design and building physics and technology in one mix of design studio and theory.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: apply by 15 Jan. 2026 rules: grades 2/3, online test 1/3; 2027 adds an online test (13 Mar) and campus day (3 Apr), full criteria not yet published.

programmes.name: Automotive Technology
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL.
programmes.about: The car as one connected high-tech system: electronics, motion and control for hybrid, electric and self-driving vehicles. Formally a major of Electrical Engineering, and the degree is a BSc Electrical Engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering and Chemistry
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL, Physics and Chemistry, one of them HL. Numerus fixus: apply by 15 January; ranked on grades and an online test (20 March 2027).
programmes.about: Chemistry and process engineering for new materials, cleaner energy and medicines, in the English-taught track; the bilingual Scheikundige Technologie has the same courses and no selection.

needs.note: Physics or Chemistry must be HL; the other can be SL.
Physics or Chemistry must be HL; the other can be SL.

programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: apply by 15 Jan 2027. Ranked on an online cognitive test on 20 March (60%) and your grades (40%); the motivation questionnaire must be done on time.

programmes.name: Computer Science and Engineering
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL. Numerus fixus: apply by 15 January; ranked on grades and an online selection day (6 March 2027).
programmes.about: How to design, build and reason about software systems and web services, including proving programs correct and efficient with formal mathematical methods, with the user kept in view.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: apply by 15 Jan 2027. Online tests on 6 March: logical reasoning 40%, algorithmic thinking 40%; your average grade 10% and maths grade 10%.

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.about: Statistics, programming, data mining and business analytics plus the law and ethics of data, in a joint degree with Tilburg University taught in both Eindhoven and Tilburg. Apply through TU/e.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL.
programmes.about: Electricity and magnetism put to work in chips, motors and wireless energy, organised around three first-year themes such as the connected world, from photonic chips to wifi.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Industrial Design
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL.
programmes.about: Designing interactive products, systems and services that combine technology, data, users and aesthetics, learned mostly through design projects: smart homes, intelligent clothing, health and play.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering
programmes.about: Business processes treated as systems to analyse, model and improve, from logistics and planning to human behaviour and data-driven decisions, through projects with industry partners.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.ib: Maths AA HL and Physics HL. Numerus fixus: apply by 15 January; ranked only on online selection tests (13 March 2027), not grades.
programmes.about: Designing and building products, machines and production processes, drawing on maths, physics and chemistry, with much of the learning done in project teams.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: apply by 15 Jan 2027. Ranked only on online tests on 13 March: maths 25%, physics 25%, a programme-content test 50%. Grades do not count.

programmes.name: Psychology & Technology
programmes.about: Psychology applied to technology: how people use and are affected by technology, and how to design new applications with that knowledge, through small-scale challenge-based projects.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

programmes.name: Sustainable Innovation
programmes.about: How sustainable technology actually gets adopted: costs, risks, regulation and social acceptance, seen from the side of citizens, government and companies, in Dutch and international context.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the subject requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete the study-choice check.

notes: A €100 non-refundable fee applies to each application from anyone schooled outside the Netherlands or at an international school there, so IB applicants pay it.
Biomedical Engineering and Medical Sciences and Technology are partly taught in Dutch and need proof of Dutch; Scheikundige Technologie is the bilingual twin of Chemical Engineering and Chemistry.
You need 45 of 60 credits in year 1 (binding study advice, 2026/27 rule), or you cannot re-enrol in that programme for three years.
